data.name: The Low Tide Run
data.description:
The chart is spent when the run starts. Health and chakra carry from fight to fight, and a lost fight ends the run.

When the tide runs far enough out, it bares the wreck's lower hull. The Tide Chart marks where the planks have opened. Go in while the water is out, and be gone before it turns.

Claim any reward choice still waiting from an earlier run before you set out.
data.successDescription: You came out of the lower hull before the tide.

objectives.description:
The sea has drawn back from the wreck, and the breach is right where the Wayfinder marked it, wide enough to walk through. Inside, the Core holds the deck the way it was: dry, lamplit, ready for sea.

A Deck Warden is counting seal charges along the bulkhead. He gets to eleven, looks up at you, and starts again from one.
The Deck Warden sets down his count and draws.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Warden falls apart into sand and seal script, and the count goes with him.

Past the breach the hold is filling again, one wave at a time. The Arsenal Keeper stands on a crate with his ledger held over the water, checking stores that floated away years ago. "Tide stores. Wet. Logged," he says, and turns a page. "You are not logged."
The Arsenal Keeper closes his ledger, and steps down into the water.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
"Unlisted," the Keeper says as he falls, and makes a note of it.

The far side of the hold opens onto the sand beneath the hull. The tide has turned. A Skyglass Sentinel stands at the waterline, shell and stone, and the surf runs up to its feet like a dog called to heel.
The Sentinel plants itself at the waterline. Behind it, the sea is gathering.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Sentinel sinks back into the sand, and the surf goes back to being only surf.

You walk out through the breach as the first wave comes back in. Behind you, the hull is already closing.
The tide comes back in over you. You wake on the sand, soaked, with nothing but the spent chart.

data.name: The Night Watch
data.description:
The roster is spent when the watch starts. Health and chakra carry from fight to fight, and a lost fight ends the run.
After the last watch, leave with what you hold or stand the Second Watch; lose it and you keep only what you held.

The duty roster still hangs by the Deck Warden's post. At the bottom, in fresh ink, someone has added a new name: yours. Stand three watches back to back, and the post is yours.

Claim any reward choice still waiting from an earlier run before you set out.
data.successDescription: You held the Deck Warden's post through the night.

objectives.description:
The deck is dark but for the lanterns. The Deck Warden stands his post by the roster board, exactly where he has stood for a generation. He reads your name off the board, then reads it again.

"New name," he says. "First watch. Hold the deck."
The Deck Warden draws. "Drill," he says. "Hold."
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
"Held," the Warden says, picking himself up, and makes a mark beside your name.

The bell strikes the middle watch. The Oathkeeper climbs to the deck in an officer's coat faded by no weather and checks the roster against a list of his own. "A roster is a term of service," he says. "Terms are kept. I will see that you keep yours."
The Oathkeeper takes the deck as if he has always had it.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
"The term holds," the Oathkeeper says, and steps back to the rail.

Near dawn, or what the Core remembers of dawn, they come together: the Deck Warden and the Oathkeeper, side by side. "Last watch," the Warden says. "Hold it and the post is yours. No one is relieved." The Oathkeeper says nothing, which is as close to agreement as he comes.
The Deck Warden and the Oathkeeper close in from both ends of the deck.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description:
The Deck Warden goes down on one knee by the roster board and looks at your name for a long time. "Post held," he says. He unhooks his lantern and hangs it on your side of the board. Then, for the first time in a generation, he sits down.

Under your name a second line has appeared, in a hand you do not know: SECOND WATCH. Down the deck, someone is whistling.

End your watch now and keep everything you hold. Stand the Second Watch and win, and it adds to the haul. Lose it and you keep only what you hold now.
The First Blade drops onto the deck, twin cleavers forming from the gale. "Finally. Something new."
objectives.failDescription: You fall back, and keep only what you held.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: You leave the Warden's lantern hanging on the board. By morning the roster has rewritten itself, and your name is gone from it.
The First Blade lies on the deck, laughing quietly. "That was new," he says. You leave the Second Watch to the gale.
You fall at your post. When you wake, there is a new name at the bottom of the roster, and it is not yours.
